priority_findings.evidence: tex/main.log lines 9164-9212: repeated longtable overfull alignments by 103.87476 pt; source layout p{4cm}cc cccccc, 9 columns, repeated 2-line metric header.

priority_findings.evidence: tex/main.log lines 9320-9368: repeated longtable overfull alignments by 115.72972 pt; same 9-column layout.
priority_findings.assessment: Does not fit the text block; needs the same coordinated width fix as A.1, sized to the larger ResNet overrun.

priority_findings.evidence: tex/main.log lines 9988-10027: longtable alignment overfull by 3.52977 pt across all sections/rows.
priority_findings.assessment: Slight width overflow. Once MaxS and AvgS are omitted in the VOC table, the remaining test tables still need a small width reduction or the font/column spacing treatment applied consistently.

priority_findings.table: Paper 1 result tables (main VGG/ResNet, full VGG/ResNet, alpha ablations)
priority_findings.evidence: arxive/hiddenMonotonicity source result tables use red cell fills for best metric values; thesis copies keep boldface but no fill. The source alpha_none/alpha_shift green fill was explicitly represented by asterisk markers instead.
priority_findings.assessment: Best-value emphasis has lost the source color cue in the main and comprehensive split-method tables. Alpha_none/alpha_shift preserve the green highlight's stated interpretation using asterisk markers, but this differs visually from PTNB's best/approx blue-cell convention.

thesis_split_method_dashes.source_semantics: Absolute saliency transformation is not applicable to these LayerCAM rows; present in source paper as '-'.
thesis_split_method_dashes.recommended_display: n/a or em dash with a note defining not applicable

thesis_split_method_dashes.cells: Max Sens. entries shown as '--' for random/baseline rows
thesis_split_method_dashes.source_semantics: No reported value in the source tables; no missing numeric value was found to restore.
thesis_split_method_dashes.recommended_display: Use one consistent unavailable marker and define it in the caption/legend. Do not impute a value.

thesis_split_method_dashes.cells: Random Baseline Layer and Abs cells shown as '-'
thesis_split_method_dashes.source_semantics: Not applicable in source; not an evaluated layer/configuration.
thesis_split_method_dashes.recommended_display: n/a or a defined not-applicable marker

ptnb_adapter_semantics.fully_empty_voc_columns: MaxS and AvgS are wholly unmeasured for VOC in the source paper, so dropping both columns is correct and preserves all measured values.
ptnb_adapter_semantics.test_and_main_config_dash: Rows without a tunable configuration are fixed; mapping the config placeholder to 'fixed' is semantically correct.
ptnb_adapter_semantics.validation_rank_sum_dash: A missing selection rank for the fixed row is n/a, not zero; mapping to n/a is correct.
ptnb_adapter_semantics.ablation_eq_dash: The Eq factor is switched on for +Eq rows; 'on' is an accurate clarification.
ptnb_adapter_semantics.correlation_diagonal: A suppressed correlation-matrix diagonal is exactly 1.00; restoring 1.00 is correct.

placeholder_audit.result: No numerical values were identified as lost in the reviewed table adaptations. Dashes found in active Paper 1 thesis tables also occur in the source paper and represent non-applicability or unreported Max Sensitivity. The PTNB VOC MaxS/AvgS omissions are correct because the source experiment did not evaluate them.

metric_semantics.split_campaign: Pixel Flipping is AUC of confidence/score drop; higher is better. Use a label such as PF-drop or PF-score-drop with an up arrow.
metric_semantics.ptnb_campaign: Pixel Flipping is AUC over remaining target logit; lower is better. Use PF-rem (remaining-logit AUC) with a down arrow.
metric_semantics.constraint: Do not use one undifferentiated PF abbreviation across both campaigns; preserve the different curve quantity, protocol and direction.

unified_style_mapping.rules: Booktabs horizontal rules, no vertical rules, compact two-line headers, consistent sans/roman table text per existing thesis convention, right-aligned decimal values, and per-table captions that define abbreviations, direction, and unavailable markers.
unified_style_mapping.best_cell: Pale blue fill RGB(190,214,238) with bold value, matching PTNB source bestcell.
unified_style_mapping.near_best_cell: Lighter blue fill RGB(226,237,248), with the existing approximate/not-significant marker, matching PTNB source approxcell.
unified_style_mapping.legacy_red_or_green: Re-express best and near-best cues through the shared blue palette while preserving bold/approx/significance meaning; retain alpha-ablation comparison-to-default marker semantics where applicable.
unified_style_mapping.placeholders: Use n/a for not applicable; use a distinct defined unavailable marker for an unreported/not-computable value. Never silently convert missing numeric data to a number.
unified_style_mapping.metric_headings: AL (up), PG (up), TK (up), PF-drop (up) for split-method tables; PF-rem (down) for PTNB; Sel (down), MaxS (down), AvgS (down). Expand each abbreviation in table caption/legend or nearby prose.
unified_style_mapping.large_tables: Longtable for multipage records, but constrain its declared column widths to the text width; reduce descriptor width, wrap configurations, abbreviate repeated metric headers, reduce inter-column padding modestly, and only use landscape if a compact portrait layout remains unreadable.

additional_observations: Main split evaluation tables use resizebox and did not produce table-alignment overflow in the stale log.
PTNB main/test/ablation generated tables already use booktabs and blue best/approx shading. The VGG CI table's 3.53 pt overflow is the only non-A.1/A.2 table alignment overflow found in tex/main.log.

The reviewed table rows and numeric tokens remain present through source-to-thesis restyling; numeric token-count mismatches in a naive text scan were due to formatting, headers and differing legend markup, not evidence of deleted metric observations.
